name: Nevada 4-H Capital Days
org: University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada 4-H
what_you_do: Visit Nevada's capital city to learn how a bill becomes a law. Follow bills and sit in on committee hearings. Tour the Legislative Building. Meet your state lawmakers.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 13 to 18 (high school students) in Nevada 4-H.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Email nevada4h@unr.edu with questions. The page does not say how to sign up for Capital Days.
notes: Activities also include a visit to the state museum and the Governor's Mansion. Ask Nevada 4-H for dates and cost.
